name: Effluent equalisation and surge management
principle: An equalisation basin between the oily-water separation and the biological stage damps flow and load spikes so downstream units see steady hydraulic and organic loading. IPIECA: flow equalisation dampens flow variations, reducing potential spikes in flow and loads to the downstream units. Industrial practice sizes equalisation for 12-24 hours of retention; IPIECA quotes about a day for desalter effluent.

performance.basis: equalisation tanks sized for 12 to 24 hours retention

source.note: Baldwin refinery effluent design note, read 2026-11-18
